### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **12** documentable anchor(s).

**3** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via PageSchema (symbol, a top-level const), OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED (literal, a string literal in REACT_PAGES_ENV))_
- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`  _(via OS_PAGE_REACT (literal, a string literal in REACT_PAGES_LEGACY_ENV), OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED (literal, a string literal in REACT_PAGES_ENV))_
- `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx`  _(via OS_PAGE_REACT (literal, a string literal in REACT_PAGES_LEGACY_ENV), OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED (literal, a string literal in REACT_PAGES_ENV))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **151** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e2a4b6a06315959625748b44ed91b1f9731c67ee` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `10fd61e0704ba33b718493556db0cf47ff768d52` — the merge of head `3d66e796cb1f06767d75fea87de9587f5762bff7` into base `e2a4b6a06315959625748b44ed91b1f9731c67ee`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 10fd61e0704ba33b718493556db0cf47ff768d52 && git checkout 10fd61e0704ba33b718493556db0cf47ff768d52
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e2a4b6a06315959625748b44ed91b1f9731c67ee 3d66e796cb1f06767d75fea87de9587f5762bff7 && git checkout -B drift-repro e2a4b6a06315959625748b44ed91b1f9731c67ee && git merge --no-ff 3d66e796cb1f06767d75fea87de9587f5762bff7

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e2a4b6a06315959625748b44ed91b1f9731c67ee
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs e2a4b6a06315959625748b44ed91b1f9731c67ee` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

Full dogfood on head `e6df92d2` (the PR head), run once as the `!` title requires:

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build` (declarations on), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the shared verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `Test Files 295 passed | 3 skipped (298)`, `Tests 2520 passed | 18 skipped (2538)`. No failures.

CI on e6df92d2, and what 87ff23f9 changes:

- **Test Core (3/8)**: `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` failed. The published `./console` entry is run from the packed tarball with nothing else installed, and `utils/console.ts` had gained an import of `@objectstack/types` (for `readEnvWithDeprecation`), which failed there with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`. The module's export census also grew by two names. Fixed in 69036206: the legacy `OS_PAGE_REACT` fallback is written in the module, its deprecation warning goes through the plugin logger once, and the reader and its constants are not exported. So the PR body's sentence about `readEnvWithDeprecation` no longer holds; the behaviour it describes is unchanged. Local runs: the pin test passed 14/14 against a rebuilt dist, `src/utils/console` passed 142/142 (the legacy case now also asserts the warning), and `tsc --noEmit` exited 0.
- **Test Core (1/8)** and **Spec property liveness**: both came from the `translation/flows.screens` citation of `service-automation/src/engine.ts`. That citation fails on main for every PR that reaches `packages/spec`. 87ff23f9 carries the same `liveness/translation.json` hunk as #25751, so either one can land first and the merge stays clean. Local runs: `check:liveness` exited 0 (`761 … pair(s) asked, 760 anchored, 1 exempt`), and `check-liveness.test.ts` passed 71/71.
- **Type Check · workspace** and **TypeScript Type Check**: the runner received a shutdown signal and Turborepo force-killed the remaining tasks. No `error TS` appears in the log. They re-run on this push.
